notes.title: Demo Refresh for MIX Fall Game Showcase!
notes.content:
Hello there munchkins!!

With the MIX Fall Game Showcase and our release just around the corner, we're back with a demo refresh!

ALSO, if you missed it, UMAMI now has a release date: get ready to get your first bite on November 17!
Wishlist UMAMI so you'll be ready when the kitchen officially opens on November 17, 2025!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/d5086c7bb27d1d4fdfa338d1dbebe2b8c898213a.png

And secondly, as UMAMI gets closer to launch, our demo could really use a refresh! 
Check out what we have been working on:

UMAMI Demo Refresh for MIX Fall Game Showcase!

It’s been a little over three months since the original UMAMI demo launched, and since then we've been hard at work behind the scenes, listening to your feedback, and polishing up the experience. As a new indie studio on the scene, we have learned so much from this experience, and we're hyped and proud to share our updates with you!

With the ongoing MIX Fall Game Showcase and our release date announcement, it was the perfect time to upgrade and update the UMAMI demo! You can now experience the first 2 puzzles of UMAMI with some improved features, accessibility and quality of life additions.

Now I know what you must be wondering... What's new in the demo?
Well we've written up a whole changelog with all the new things that you can expect!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/f9c11072856ade72dd1cc89c45437da84266bc79.png
Demo Changelog

 Added controller support
 Added keyboard support (WASD for camera + Q/E for piece rotation)
 Added "Click to hold" feature (highly requested)
 Added white outline when you hover the puzzle pieces that are not yet placed
 Updated/polished art
 Revamped 'Settings' panel
 Revamped 'Tutorial'
 Added new 'Controls' panel
 Added hotkey to toggle 'Settings' (Space)
 [Settings - PC]: Added V-sync toggle
 [Settings - Mouse]: Added zoom speed slider

[Settings - Controllers]:
 Invert camera rotation
 Invert zoom
 Camera speed (Vertical and Horizontal)
 Zoom speed
 Vibration

WIP for the next update: Full Steam Deck compatibility
 New features (including the possibility to toggle a timer and a list of your best times on each puzzle)
 Further art/audio improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/211fa190940f047e1dda658e8b009a5c02d974fa.png
Found a bug or have feedback?

We done our best to ensure smooth gameplay for this demo refresh, but if there is anything that fell through the cracks, or you have a suggestion, you can do 1 of 3 things: 
Fill out the feedback form at the end of the demo
Join our Discord, where we have dedicated channels for bug reports and suggestions
Post on the UMAMI Steam forum
Thank you so much to everyone for your support! 

If you're excited for UMAMI, and love meeting other cozy gamers + food and puzzle lovers. 
Feel free to join the community on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/212c47bcb5c9829f5956e1608cd1b8ad78aa29b4.png

notes.title: UMAMI Opens its Kitchen – November 17, 2025!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2521UmubkRU;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been quite the journey filled with development, fine-tuning, and plenty of trial-and-error in the kitchen (plus the occasional kitchen fire), but we can finally see the finish line! 

On November 17, you'll be able to snap puzzle pieces into place, pet cute animals, and savor a cozy feast of food and childhood nostalgia.

🍂 Cozy season, cozy game

Fall is the perfect season to release UMAMI! 🍁 It is the ultimate comfort-food puzzle game!
As the days get colder and darker, we wanted UMAMI to feel like a warm bowl of soup, a soft blanket, and a slow afternoon all wrapped into one. It's a little escape into cuteness, nostalgia, and the quiet joy of putting things together.

That’s why we're so excited to announce our release date as part of the MIX Fall Game Showcase! The event is live now on August 29th and full of amazing titles and special highlights.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/a3f03d842b52dfd7eb277c17e20dc4805c32cdf2.png
🥧 What's cooking next?

We have been working on a big update to the UMAMI demo thanks to your feedback, adding controller support as well as accessibility and quality-of-life improvements! The update will be available next week, and we will be sharing a full breakdown of what's new in a follow-up blog post!

If you'd like to stay in the loop with all things UMAMI and become part of the community, feel free to join our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/212c47bcb5c9829f5956e1608cd1b8ad78aa29b4.png

Let the countdown to November 17 begin!!!

Wishlist UMAMI so you'll be notified the second the kitchen opens its doors this Fall!

notes.title: Demo Update: QOL & Bug Fixing
notes.content:
Hello UMAMI fans! 🥰

We are excited to announce some new updates for our cozy tasty puzzle game that we hope will make the demo even more fun and enjoyable!!
Thank you so much for your feedback and your messages! They're super helpful in making UMAMI even better, and we really appreciate that you took the time to share it with us 💜

Control improvements
We have added the two most requested features!

The ability to rotate AND zoom in/out the camera while you are holding a puzzle piece!
Without it, you had to pick up and let go of the piece to either zoom in, out, or turn the puzzle around, so it required a lot more clicking. Hopefully, this makes things a little easier and more comfortable!
You can now rotate the puzzle while holding a piece by using LMB + RMB. It allows you to easily get a look at every side of each puzzle while holding a piece.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/5384fdfbb2e21bbe8f98a036a3e2be2b451511d2.gif

The camera can now also zoom while holding pieces by using LMB + RMB + Mouse Wheel.
You can get up close or further to the puzzle while holding a piece, making it easier to evaluate their placement with precision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/d1235771ec4ec4555426daa192f7bb28ee86c011.gif

The camera no longer zooms with LMB + Mouse Wheel.
New Tutorial
We’ve also revamped the onboarding with a detailed tutorial to help with that first moment of “where do I begin?”. This includes short GIFs to visually explain the core interactions: how to control the camera, the pieces, where and how to place them.

Here’s a peek at the new tutorial: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/89f5e77a5d7e7629198e6c6f195c2b6277d03c47.png

Bug Fixing
We’ve also tackled a frustrating bug to keep your puzzles flowing smoothly:
Fixed an issue where pieces could get stuck inside the puzzle due to unintentional detachment from magnets, forcing a restart of the puzzle. Now, your pieces stay securely in place!
If you try out the updated demo, we’d love to hear your thoughts! 
Your feedback is incredibly valuable to me, so please don't forget to fill out the feedback form here: UMAMi Demo Feedback Form

Or, if you want to have a chat directly with us in the dev team, and exchange with other players, come join the Discord! 

Thank you for your continued support of UMAMI, and we hope that you enjoy these updates!
💛

notes.title: UMAMI is here - Introducing our cozy puzzle game!
notes.content:
We’re so excited to finally reveal UMAMI, and can’t *wait* for you to experience it!!!

UMAMI is a 3D food-themed puzzle game where every level is a hand-crafted sensory experience, built to satisfy the eye, the ear, and that quiet part of your brain that craves harmony… and food.

In UMAMI, you’ll solve small, food-themed dioramas, each with its own combination of playful logic, hidden secrets, cute animals, and beautifully stylized ingredients. 

Every piece and object is hand-painted, every click and movement carefully tuned to create a satisfying, soothing experience.
The puzzles are gentle, but clever.
The music is warm and calm.
The result? A game that doesn’t just feel cozy; it feels *good* to play.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/f9c11072856ade72dd1cc89c45437da84266bc79.png
Announcement Trailer

We’re proud to share our very first trailer with you!
A taste of the UMAMI vibe, and the kinds of gameplay and puzzles you'll be diving into.

[previewyoutube=GMUN2BwDLQg;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope it makes you smile, and maybe even a little bit hungry. 👀🍩🥤

A wishlist goes a long way for small studios like us, so if you enjoy what you see, wishlist UMAMI here!

A taste of what you’ll find in UMAMI
🖌️ Hand-painted beauty: Every level is a little art piece, full of charm and details!
🎧 Soothing sound design: From satisfying clicks to shimmering sparkly sounds.
🧠 Gentle puzzles: Built for curiosity, not frustration!
🧺 Cozy, calming atmosphere: Like tidying a bento box for the soul.
🥢 Tactile feel: Tinker, explore, and organize in ways that just feel right.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/0856c22e144e4b6d2600a9a12bd041f4fe9199b0.png
DEMO COMING SOON!

UMAMI will have a free playable demo releasing in the upcoming weeks, that will also be available during Steam Next Fest!
You’ll be able to dive into the world of UMAMI, and experience what it is all about: cozy vibes, gentle logic, and sensory, food-themed joy. We can’t wait for you to try it!

Don’t forget to wishlist it now so you’re notified the moment it’s out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611710/cb9e8bd45589322ded01dd250bc797cf313b733f.gif

Introducing...

We aim to create soothing and comforting games to life, ones that leave you feeling better than you did before you started playing.
